title: Asking for a Day Off
paragraphs: Hafiz needs to attend his sister's wedding next month, which falls on a normal working day, so he decides to ask his manager for a day off well in advance instead of waiting until the last minute.

He writes a short, polite email explaining the situation and offering to finish an urgent report before he leaves. His manager approves the request quickly and even wishes his sister well for the occasion.
A coworker later mentions that she once asked for time off only two days before an event and had a much harder time getting it approved because the team had no chance to plan around her absence.
Hafiz feels relieved that he planned ahead instead of stressing about it later. He learns that clear, early communication at work usually makes both sides feel more comfortable and respected.
